577207.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Suffern
577207.note: No source found (its own site gives no year). therebbesimpact.com: 2007; chabad.org's listing number (577207) is from about 2007 too; the IRS ruling for Congregation Chabad Jewish Center of Suffern Inc. is March 2010. Directed by Rabbi Shmuel and Devorah Gancz (the directory still names Rabbi Isaac Lefkowitz). Its chabad.org listing went up on Oct 9 2007 (chabad.org's own record), so it existed by then. Archived copies of its chabad.org listing (Wayback Machine) show it at 123 Route 59, Suffern (Feb 2010, Nov 2011, Jan 2015); it is now at 350 Haverstraw Road, Montebello, listed there by Apr 2016, so it moved there between Jan 2015 and Apr 2016. Its listing was already archived in June 2008, after the listing went up (Oct 9 2007), so this adds no earlier bound.

earlier.where: 123 Route 59, Suffern (its address on its chabad.org listing as archived Feb 11 2010 to Jan 23 2015)
